description: Use when a site has no entitymap.json, or to replace a wrong one. Returns a starter entitymap.json built from the domain's latest scan record: business name, phone, coordinates and declared service areas as entities with SERVES relations. Fields the site never stated are marked TODO, never guessed. Read-only; needs a prior scan of the domain (run scan_domain first if there is none).
name: fix_entitymap
title: Fix an entity map
